title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Graphic Designer – Social Media \& Creative Campaigns**

Location: **Ahmedabad, Gujarat**

Experience: **1–3 Years**

Employment Type: **Full\-Time**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **creative and visually driven Graphic Designer** who can take ideas from concept to execution. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of **social media design, campaign concepts, visual storytelling, video editing, and motion graphics**.

You will be responsible for creating engaging visual content for social media, digital campaigns, product promotions, brand communication, and marketing initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design high\-quality **social media creatives** for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, etc.
* Develop creative concepts and visual directions for **marketing campaigns and brand communication**.
* Think beyond templates and bring **fresh, original creative ideas** to campaigns.
* Create designs for posts, stories, reels, ads, banners, promotional creatives, and other digital assets.
* Edit short\-form videos and social media content, including **Reels and promotional videos**.
* Create basic to advanced **motion graphics, animations, transitions, and kinetic typography**.
* Collaborate with the marketing and content teams to convert ideas, briefs, and campaigns into strong visual communication.
* Maintain consistency in **brand identity, typography, colors, layouts, and visual language**.
* Adapt creative concepts into multiple formats and platforms.
* Stay updated with current **design trends, social media trends, content formats, and visual styles**.
* Handle multiple projects and deliver creatives within deadlines.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator**.
* Good understanding of **After Effects and Premiere Pro** or equivalent video/motion tools.
* Strong **visual sense, typography, composition, color theory, and layout skills**.
* Good understanding of **social media creative formats and trends**.
* Ability to think conceptually and develop **campaign ideas from scratch**.
* Good video editing and storytelling skills.
* Basic to strong knowledge of **motion graphics and animation**.
* Ability to understand a brief and independently convert it into a creative visual solution.
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to experiment with new creative styles.

**Who We’re Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is not just a **designer**, but a **creative thinker**.

Someone who can say:

**“Here’s the idea, here’s how we can execute it, and here’s how we can make it stand out.”**

**A strong portfolio showcasing social media creatives, campaign concepts, video editing, and motion graphics will be highly p**

**referred.**

**Bonus Skills**

* **Experience with Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar tools.**
* **Knowledge of AI\-based creative/design tools.**
* **Experience creating content for e\-commerce, D2C, lifestyle, fashion, home \& living, or consumer brands.**
* **Understanding of performance marketing creatives and ad design.**

**Send your CV \+ Portfolio to yash@myarmor.in**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

description:
**Job Title:** Interior Designer \+ Operations Executive  
**Location:** South Bopal, Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time

**About Neo Homes**  
Neo Homes is an interior design and modular furniture company based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. We're looking for a passionate Design Intern to join our growing team and gain hands\-on experience in residential and commercial interior design projects.

**About the Role**  
We are looking for a **creative, confident and well\-organized Interior Designer \+ Operations Executive** to join our team. The role involves a combination of **interior/modular furniture design, client handling, showroom management and day\-to\-day operations**.

The candidate should be comfortable working with clients, understanding their requirements, taking site measurements, preparing 2D/3D designs and drawings, coordinating with the execution team, and ensuring smooth project and showroom operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle clients visiting the showroom.
* Take accurate **site measurements** and understand site conditions.
* Prepare **2D layouts, plans, elevations and detailed drawings**.
* Create **3D designs and presentations** as per client requirements.
* Work proficiently with **AutoCAD and relevant 3D design software**.
* Develop designs based on space, functionality, aesthetics and client requirements.
* Discuss designs with clients and make revisions based on their feedback.
* Prepare drawings and details required for production and execution.
* Coordinate with clients, production teams, vendors, contractors and installation teams.
* Coordinate site visits, measurements, deliveries and installations.
* Handle day\-to\-day **showroom and operational activities**.

Skills Required

* Strong knowledge of **AutoCAD \& Photoshop**
* Good knowledge of **2D \& 3D designing**
* Ability to take accurate **site measurements**
* Understanding of modular furniture and interior execution
* Knowledge of furniture layouts, materials, finishes and hardware
* Good client communication and presentation skills
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills
* Good organizational and time\-management abilities
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously
* Willingness to travel for site visits when required
* Attention to detail and ability to work independently

Qualification \& Experience

* Diploma/Degree in **Interior Design, Architecture, Furniture Design or a related field**
* 1–3 years of relevant experience preferred
* Experience in **modular kitchens, wardrobes, furniture or interior execution** will be an advantage.
* Experience in client handling and showroom sales will be an added advantage.
